_note: Demo trades client with made-up details. Quote visits are booked on a GHL calendar; won jobs are GHL opportunities.

summary.targets: quote booking rate 50% or better, cost per lead under $60
levers: Google Ads budget and which services are advertised
how fast the office calls back new enquiries
follow-up on quotes not yet accepted
which suburbs and job types the ads target
quirks: Cost per job won is blended across all jobs, including referrals.
Won value is the quoted price when the job is accepted, not the final invoice.

metrics.label: New enquiries
metrics.definition: New contacts created that day, not tagged staff, spam or supplier.

metrics.label: Enquiries from Google Ads
metrics.definition: New enquiries whose source maps to Google Ads.

metrics.label: Quote visits booked
metrics.definition: Quote visits created that day on the Quote visit calendar.

metrics.label: Quote booking rate
metrics.definition: Quote visits booked divided by new enquiries.

metrics.label: Jobs won
metrics.definition: Jobs pipeline opportunities marked Won that day.

metrics.label: Value of jobs won
metrics.definition: Total quoted value of jobs marked Won that day.

metrics.label: Google Ads spend
metrics.definition: Google Ads spend that day, ex GST.

metrics.label: Cost per lead
metrics.definition: Google Ads spend divided by enquiries from Google Ads.

metrics.label: Cost per job won (blended)
metrics.definition: Google Ads spend divided by all jobs won.

metrics.label: Revenue invoiced
metrics.definition: Sales invoices dated that day, ex GST, excluding draft and voided.
